title: The Geometry of Musical Rhythm: What Makes a “Good” Rhythm Good?

title: Computational geometric aspects of rhythm, melody, and voice-leading

title: Maximally Even Sets

title: Kid Algebra: Radiohead's Euclidean and Maximally Even Rhythms

title: Effects of instructed timing and tempo on snare drum sound in drum kit performance

note: Playing ahead of or behind the beat changes the sound of the stroke, not only its position. title: Unplayed Melodies: Javanese Gamelan and the Genesis of Music Theory

note: Bell sets whose measured pitches are the material evidence for early Chinese pitch standards. An instrument as the surviving record of a tuning system, which is a different kind of evidence from a treatise about one. — access: closed — verified via crossref (2026-09-08)
